g.text: CN3791 MPPT Li-ion charger: up to 4x 5V solar panels (diode OR) -> 1S LiPo (4.2V)

g.desc: CN3791 MPPT Li-ion charger: up to 4x 5V solar panels (diode OR) -> 1S LiPo (4.2V)

g.text: INA3221 I2C power monitor (0x42): battery, total solar and panel 1

g.desc: INA3221 I2C power monitor (0x42): battery, total solar and panel 1

g.text: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819W (SOD-123, 40V/1A). MPPT senses VIN after these diodes,

g.desc: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819W (SOD-123, 40V/1A). MPPT senses VIN after these diodes,

g.text: so each panel sits ~0.3-0.45V above the 4.42V setpoint (~4.7-4.9V: under a cool panel's ~5V Vmp, nearer a hot one's). Up to 0.5A per input.

g.desc: so each panel sits ~0.3-0.45V above the 4.42V setpoint (~4.7-4.9V: under a cool panel's ~5V Vmp, nearer a hot one's). Up to 0.5A per input.

g.text: - Charge current: ICH = 120mV / R5 = 120mV / 0.15R = 0.8A, leaving margin on the 1.0A connector contacts (R5 = 0.24R for 0.5A).

g.desc: - Charge current: ICH = 120mV / R5 = 120mV / 0.15R = 0.8A, leaving margin on the 1.0A connector contacts (R5 = 0.24R for 0.5A).

g.text: - MPPT setpoint: VMPPT = 1.205V x (1 + R3/R4) = 1.205 x (1 + 26.7k/10k) = 4.42V. Charging starts once MPPT > 1.23V (VIN > 4.51V).

g.desc: - MPPT setpoint: VMPPT = 1.205V x (1 + R3/R4) = 1.205 x (1 + 26.7k/10k) = 4.42V. Charging starts once MPPT > 1.23V (VIN > 4.51V).

g.text: - L1: datasheet requires L > 5 x (VCC - VBAT) uH = 16uH at 6V Voc / 2.8V batt. 22uH gives ~0.2A ripple at 6V in, 3.7V batt.

g.desc: - L1: datasheet requires L > 5 x (VCC - VBAT) uH = 16uH at 6V Voc / 2.8V batt. 22uH gives ~0.2A ripple at 6V in, 3.7V batt.

g.text: - Datasheet blocking diode D1 omitted to save ~0.4V headroom: D5-D8 keep the battery out of the panels; the CN3791 then draws ~21uA

g.desc: - Datasheet blocking diode D1 omitted to save ~0.4V headroom: D5-D8 keep the battery out of the panels; the CN3791 then draws ~21uA

g.text: from the battery via L1 and Q1's body diode when dark (datasheet p.9). Reference D1 is intentionally unused.

g.desc: from the battery via L1 and Q1's body diode when dark (datasheet p.9). Reference D1 is intentionally unused.

g.text: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input, VIN < VBAT, or JP1 open.

g.desc: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input, VIN < VBAT, or JP1 open.

g.text: - Power connectors J1-J6 are 2-pin Micro JST 1.25 / PicoBlade-compatible (1.0A per contact); J9 I2C is the 4-pin version.

g.desc: - Power connectors J1-J6 are 2-pin Micro JST 1.25 / PicoBlade-compatible (1.0A per contact); J9 I2C is the 4-pin version.

g.text: J7/J8 are 2.54mm pin headers for panel-mount SPST switches, or a jumper cap if unused. J1-J6 share one type, so check the silkscreen before plugging in.

g.desc: J7/J8 are 2.54mm pin headers for panel-mount SPST switches, or a jumper cap if unused. J1-J6 share one type, so check the silkscreen before plugging in.

g.text: Polarity: J1-J6 pin 1 = +, pin 2 = GND. The board marks + and - at each of these connectors. Q2 blocks a reversed cell on J5.

g.desc: Polarity: J1-J6 pin 1 = +, pin 2 = GND. The board marks + and - at each of these connectors. Q2 blocks a reversed cell on J5.

g.text: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.desc: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.text: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.desc: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.text: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3791 sees no battery and VBAT pulses near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.desc: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3791 sees no battery and VBAT pulses near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.text: - INA3221 (U2, I2C 0x42: A0 = SDA, the Meshtastic and MeshCore default). CH1 = R6 battery (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging;

g.desc: - INA3221 (U2, I2C 0x42: A0 = SDA, the Meshtastic and MeshCore default). CH1 = R6 battery (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging;

g.text: CH2 = R7 solar total (PV -> VIN); CH3 = R10 panel 1 alone (J1 -> D5). Bus voltage is read at each IN- pin: cell, VIN, panel 1.

g.desc: CH2 = R7 solar total (PV -> VIN); CH3 = R10 panel 1 alone (J1 -> D5). Bus voltage is read at each IN- pin: cell, VIN, panel 1.

g.text: All shunts 0.1R, as both firmwares assume: +/-163.8mV full scale = +/-1.64A, 0.4mA steps. Alert outputs unused; VPU tied to VS.

g.desc: All shunts 0.1R, as both firmwares assume: +/-163.8mV full scale = +/-1.64A, 0.4mA steps. Alert outputs unused; VPU tied to VS.

g.text: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 GND, 3 SCL, 4 SDA. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.

g.desc: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 GND, 3 SCL, 4 SDA. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.
